scope_note: Every factual claim (numeric or event-level) stated in the four Phase-1 reports, extracted with its cited or implied source and a claim status. Interpretive judgments (ratings, narrative labels) are not extracted as facts except where they carry a checkable number. Reports were read only; they were not modified. No claim was re-fetched from its primary source in this pass, so statuses reflect what each report reported, plus internal arithmetic checks.

status_legend.cached: Value taken from pipeline cache (yf.py / ta.py, source: cache) as stated by the report. Not re-fetched in this pass.
status_legend.derived: Computed by the report from other values. Arithmetic re-checked where the inputs were given.
status_legend.web_primary_cited: Event or figure attributed to a primary source (IR release, SEC filing, company press release) but reached only through a search summary or aggregator. Primary not opened.
status_legend.web_secondary: Figure from a secondary or aggregator source (news site, data aggregator, social sentiment site).
status_legend.estimate: Forecast, expected date or planned event as stated by the report.
status_legend.conflicting: Contradicted by another claim in this evidence set. See cross_report_conflicts.
status_legend.internal_mismatch: Figures inside the same report do not reconcile arithmetically. See internal_checks.
status_legend.provenance_unclear: Value is reported, but the report does not establish where the underlying data came from.
status_legend.flagged_uncertain: The source report itself marks the item as unverified, unconfirmed or of unknown cause.
status_legend.unsourced: The report gives no source for this claim.
status_legend.excluded_by_report: The source report itself excluded this item from its analysis. Recorded for completeness.
